newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Securities in assets purchase.
newsitem.headline: Asia Securities in assets purchase.

text.p: Asia Securities International Ltd had entered in an agreement to buy assets for cash, the company said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday.
The statement said "the company entered into an agreement on 8th April, 1997 in relation to the acquisition of assets at consideration payable wholly in cash".
"The acquisition constitutes a notifiable transaction," it said. The company gave no further details on the deal.
Asia Securities said an announcement giving further details of the acquisition would be released as soon as possible.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Asia Securities shares rose HK$0.45 or 18.18 percent to HK$2.925 in late trade on Tuesday on volume of 15.22 million shares.
